fieldDescription: Officers continue earning exp at max level as mastery exp. Multiplies the mastery exp gained from each point of exp earned past max level (Default: 1).
Fraction of mastery exp earned that is additionally gained as global mastery exp. Global mastery exp may substitute for officer mastery exp (Default: 0.1).
Multiplies the mastery exp a respec costs. At 1 a respec costs the exp needed to reach the officer's level from level 1 (Default: 1).
